title: Climate-driven shifts in tree phenology: global patterns, trends, and ecological implications
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2026, 5,726-752
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00292C, Critical Review

This review examines how major climate drivers regulate tree phenology across biomes and outlines the implications for ecosystem functioning, carbon cycling, forest productivity, and vegetation modelling.
